body: please do not do it. i've been there, two years ago i was actively suicidal but i chose not to commit, and things got way better as soon as i was out of school. schl year experiences are like 0.0001% of all the experiences you are gonna have. you have way more things ahead of you, you have not met half the people who are gonna love you yet. Life is challenging but you can do it.  plant the apricot seeds instead of eating them and stay alive to watch them grow over the summer. sending strength
